category.name: Voice agents and telephony
category.description: Place and receive phone calls handled by AI voice agents, real-time audio/video rooms.

entries.name: Bland AI
entries.free_tier: free credits + inbound number on signup (Start plan), no credit card required
entries.desc_en: Programmatically create AI phone agents and place/manage automated outbound and inbound calls.
entries.notes: MCP server rate-limited to 120 req/min/org; distinguishes read-only vs destructive operations.

entries.name: Deepgram Voice Agent API
entries.desc_en: Run a full-duplex speech-to-speech voice agent pipeline (STT+LLM+TTS) over a WebSocket API.
entries.notes: Primarily an STT/TTS/voice-agent infra layer, often paired with a telephony provider like Twilio to reach phone calls.

entries.name: ElevenLabs Agents Platform
entries.free_tier: free plan: 10k credits/month shared across ElevenLabs products
entries.desc_en: Build and deploy conversational AI voice agents with telephony (SIP/Twilio) integration via API and SDKs.
entries.notes: Official hosted MCP server uses OAuth (sign in with ElevenLabs account) rather than a raw API key; core REST API uses api-key auth.

entries.name: LiveKit Cloud
entries.auth_hint: API key + secret sign a JWT access token sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>
entries.free_tier: free Build plan: 1,000 agent session minutes/mo, 5,000 WebRTC participant minutes/mo, 50GB data transfer
entries.desc_en: Build and deploy real-time voice AI agents with SIP telephony support using LiveKit's server SDKs and APIs.
entries.notes: Self-hosted open-source option also exists; Cloud is the managed offering with usage-based billing beyond the free tier.

entries.name: Retell AI
entries.free_tier: $10 free credit on signup, then pay-as-you-go ($0.07-$0.31/min for voice)
entries.desc_en: Build, deploy, and manage AI voice agents that handle phone and web calls via REST API and SDKs.

entries.name: Synthflow API
entries.free_tier: self-serve free trial to build/test agents (pay only for actual calls); enterprise plans from ~$30k/yr for scale
entries.desc_en: Create and manage AI phone voice agents and trigger/manage outbound calls programmatically via REST API.
entries.notes: Go-to-market leans enterprise-sales for scaled deployments; a self-serve trial with API access exists for building/testing.

entries.name: Twilio Programmable Voice
entries.auth_hint: Basic Auth (Account SID + Auth Token) or API Key/Secret
entries.free_tier: trial account with free trial credit (~$15), then pay-as-you-go
entries.desc_en: Programmatically make, receive, and control phone calls (IVR, recording, conferencing) via REST API.
entries.notes: Widely used as the underlying telephony carrier beneath voice-agent platforms (Vapi, Retell, ElevenLabs, LiveKit) for actual call carriage.

entries.name: Vapi
entries.free_tier: $5 free credit on signup, then pay-as-you-go (~$0.05/min platform fee + provider costs)
entries.desc_en: Create, configure, and run AI voice assistants that make and receive phone calls via REST API.
entries.notes: Also has an official MCP server (streamable-HTTP and SSE endpoints) exposing assistants/calls/phone numbers as tools.
